'''Ktil''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ktilac]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was a part of the [[Ktilac Regions/Legends|Ktilac Regions]], a group of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] which the Ktilac co-inhabited with the [[Murachaun]]s and the [[Tocoyan]]s. Ktil had become a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[17,000 BBY]], and it eventually became a part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] as well.

==Description==
Ktil was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Ktil system/Legends|Ktil system]], a part of the [[Ktilac Regions/Legends|Ktilac Regions]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Around [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected Ktil to the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Belnar system/Legends|Belnar system]].<ref name="TEA" /> Approximately [[17,000 BBY|five millennia]] later, additional [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes linked it to the [[Sistooine system|Sistooine]] and [[Tirahnn system/Legends|Tirahnn systems]]. Furthermore, by [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]], the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida system]] had become the closest neighbor to Ktil along the route to [[Belnar/Legends|Belnar]].<ref name="EGTW" /> That set of hyperlanes persisted until the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] of [[3996 BBY]] but had ceased to exist by the onset of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] in [[3976 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:Ktilac_Regions.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Ktil was a part of the Ktilac Regions.]]
By 22,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], Ktil was considered a part of the region known as the [[Rim]], which lay beyond the boundaries of the young [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding the planet was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] and [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> By 17,000 BBY, Ktil had become a part of the Republic, lying along hyperlanes controlled by the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] and its allies in their [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|political struggle]] against the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Ktil was situated in the territories either unaligned with or contested by the Republic and the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Sith Wars]], by which [[Time/Legends|time]] the extent of the former had been greatly reduced.<ref name="TEA" />

Ktil had returned into the fold of the Republic by the time the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], with the Republic's [[Third Mid Rim Army|Third Sector Army]] being charged with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the planet's vicinity. By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], however, Ktil had been incorporated into the territory controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the planet was a part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[12 ABY/Legends|twenty-nine years]] later.<ref name="EGTW" /> As part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], at some point between [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of the Ktil system|attacked]] and conquered the Ktil [[Star system/Legends|system]], but it was no longer under the control of the invaders in 27 ABY.<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
Ktil was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ktilac]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Ktilac ruled over sixty-three [[Star/Legends|star]] systems in the Ktilac Regions, the latter of which they co-inhabited with the [[Murachaun]] and [[Tocoyan]] species. The systems controlled by the Ktilac were closed to outsiders. Around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the population of Ktil numbered between ten and one hundred million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ktil was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-9.<ref name="TEA" />
